facts.statement: Apple classifies M4 as Apple GPU family 9.
Apple GPU family 9 supports SIMD-scoped reduction operations.
Apple GPU family 9 has a theoretical maximum of 1024 threads per threadgroup; the selected pipeline may expose a lower maximum.
Apple GPU family 9 exposes a 32768-byte maximum threadgroup-memory allocation.
Apple GPU family 9 requires 16-byte threadgroup-memory allocation alignment.
Metal threadgroup memory is shared by threads in one threadgroup for that threadgroup's execution lifetime.
Metal simd_sum reduces across the active threads of one SIMDgroup and makes the result available to active threads in that SIMDgroup.
The documented simd_sum input types do not include bfloat, so BF16 contributions must be converted before the proposed FP32 reduction.
Cross-SIMDgroup publication through threadgroup memory requires a threadgroup barrier executed by all live threads with mem_threadgroup ordering; a SIMDgroup-only barrier is insufficient.
Apple instructs Metal programs not to assume SIMDgroup size; the host queries MTLComputePipelineState.threadExecutionWidth and a shader can use threads_per_simdgroup.
The selected MTLComputePipelineState.maxTotalThreadsPerThreadgroup is the runtime per-pipeline dispatch limit and may be below the family ceiling.

A dispatch must account for the selected pipeline's staticThreadgroupMemoryLength plus aligned dynamic threadgroup allocation and keep the total within device.maxThreadgroupMemoryLength as well as the family ceiling.
A positive supportsFamily query means the requested Apple GPU family or a newer family is supported; it does not assert exact family identity.
The sanitized local Apple M4 engineering probe observed supports Apple GPU family 9 or newer as true.
The sanitized local Apple M4 engineering probe observed maxThreadgroupMemoryLength equal to 32768 bytes.
Both probed local Apple M4 compute pipelines reported threadExecutionWidth equal to 32.
Both probed local Apple M4 compute pipelines reported maxTotalThreadsPerThreadgroup equal to 1024.

repository_snapshot.reproducibility_note: Raw probe output was not retained. The Git parent revision binds only the probe source used at observation time; it does not preserve the device state or make the observation automatically reproducible.

non_evidentiary_context.context_note: The Target and finite graph-specific Metal lowering at the bound Git parent revision are inspected only to locate the implementation gap. The revision identifies those historical repository inputs; it is not hardware evidence, does not reproduce the discarded probe output, is not modified by this stage, and cannot presently materialize the proposed scratch allocation or cross-SIMDgroup barrier.

assumptions: The cited 2026 vendor PDFs apply to the Metal language and Apple GPU family exposed by the local macOS toolchain used for later review.
The vendor webpage statements recorded here match the pages inspected online; their content was not captured or content-hash-verified for offline replay.

The sanitized local probe fields faithfully preserve the relevant pipeline observations while intentionally discarding raw output and device identifiers; the Git parent revision binds the historical probe source but cannot make the observation automatically reproducible.

checks: Source and fact identifiers, fact scope and authority, local-observation sanitization, and fixed evidence boundaries are structurally consistent.
Validation does not fetch unpinned webpages, interpret vendor prose, or promote a fact record into a mapping decision.

blocking_reviews: Confirm every vendor-document locator and the applicability of each atomic fact to the proposed Metal specialization.
Confirm that sanitized local observations remain scoped to the two probed pipelines and make no family-wide, performance, or scientific claim.

non_claims: The two observed width-32 pipelines do not establish a fixed SIMDgroup width for every Apple GPU, every Apple GPU family 9 device, or every future pipeline.
supports_apple9_or_newer is a lower-bound capability observation, not proof that the local device is exactly and only Apple GPU family 9.
The local probe is engineering verification only: it contains no timing, occupancy, calibration, evaluation, or scientific evidence.
Vendor support for the ingredients does not establish that the proposed mapping is correct, performant, expressible in the current IR, or supported by the current lowering.
